args.content:
## Landscape Summary
- 11 systems: corp.itsm, emarsys.cx, my.mes, sap.ariba, sap.crm, sap.ehs, sap.odm, sap.s4, sap.sf, siemens.plm, workday.hcm

## PRODUCT TRANSITION & SALES COORDINATION
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesProductChangeCoordinator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; automates notification to affected customer accounts/opportunities; coordinates cross-functional communication between product and sales teams
- **emarsys.cx:agent:ProductLifecycleOrchestrator:v1** - Monitors engineering changes; triggers coordinated customer engagement campaigns; orchestrates sales communications to affected segments

## ANALYTICS & REPORTING FOR SERVICE TO PRODUCTION
- **corp.itsm:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - Generates diagnostic reports, analyzes incident patterns (service resolution), examines equipment status (maintenance patterns), links to change requests (change impact), recommends preventive measures (continuous improvement)

## COMPENSATION RESOURCES (Generic)
- **workday.hcm:agent:CompensationAdjustmentAutomation:v1** - Merit increases and compensation based on performance/tenure
- **sap.sf:agent:CompensationPolicyAutomationEngine:v1** - Policy-driven salary adjustments, employee lifecycle changes

## SALES COMPENSATION & PERFORMANCE (NEW)
- **sap.crm:agent:SalesCompensationOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ CORE for sales comp review: Monitors sales performance metrics & employee compensation eligibility; processes compensation claims against policies; orchestrates adjustments based on real-time opportunity closure & quota attainment data; perfect for product launch incentive alignment

## SERVICE REQUEST & ORDER CAPTURE
- **sap.s4:agent:OpportunityToOrderAutomationEngine** - Converts sales opportunities to customer orders
- **corp.itsm agents process ServiceTickets** - IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer, IncidentSafetyCoordinator
- **sap.ariba** - Purchase Order Network API for procurement orders

## SUPPLY CHAIN RISK & COMPLIANCE
- **sap.ehs:agent:VendorComplianceAutomationOrchestrator:v1** - Validates vendor safety certifications
- **sap.ariba:agent:SupplierComplianceAndIncidentMonitor:v1** - Supply chain risk mitigation
- **sap.ariba:agent:MaterialAndEngineeringChangeCoordinator:v1** - Material specs validation, engineering changes, compliance requirements

## PRODUCTION MONITORING & INCIDENT ANALYSIS
- **sap.ehs:agent:IncidentRootCauseAnalyzer:v1** - ⭐ CORE for safety incident monitoring: Autonomously analyzes SafetyIncident data, generates structured RCA reports with corrective/preventive actions prioritized by risk severity & regulatory impact; identifies root causes & systemic compliance risks; part of ProductComplianceManufacturing process
- **siemens.plm:agent:QualityAssuranceAndDefectPrevention:v1** - Monitors Machine/ProductionOrder/QualityInspection
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionQualityMonitor:v1** - Detects quality deviations

## PRODUCTION SCHEDULING & RESOURCE ALLOCATION
- **my.mes:agent:ProductionChangeOrchestrator:v1** - Orchestrates production scheduling (schedule-machines, sequence-work-orders), coordinate-material-flow, orchestrate-production-execution; monitors change requests, automates impact assessments on materials/product items; CORE RESOURCE for ProductComplianceManufacturing process

## WORKFORCE & RESOURCE ALLOCATION
- **sap.sf:agent:SkillsAndCapabilityMatchingOrchestrator:v1** - ⭐ CORE for product transition readiness: Monitors employee competencies & engineering change requests; evaluates capability gaps; recommends development/reassignment; facilitates dynamic workforce planning; matches personnel skills to organizational needs in product transitions

## PRODUCT HAZARDOUS SUBSTANCE COMPLIANCE
- **sap.ehs:agent:SafetyComplianceAutomationCoordinator:v1** - Automates safety validation across materials/product items, enforces compliance, validates BOM, detects safety risks & regulatory gaps, initiates remediation for hazardous substance compliance

## ORGANIZATIONAL CHANGE MANAGEMENT
- **corp.itsm:agent:AssetProvisioningOrchestrator:v1** - Coordinates asset lifecycle provisioning across engineering changes; part of ProductTransitionSafetyCoordination, ProductionTransitionWorkforce, ProductComplianceWorkforceSafety BPMN/CMMN processes

args.reason: This agent evaluates workforce capability and identifies skill gaps by monitoring employee competencies against engineering changes and recommending targeted development/reassignment actions for product transition readiness.
